title: Time and Days of the Week

001: Is that so? The meeting will start soon.
Yes, it starts at three forty-five.
Then we have fifteen minutes left.
Yes, let's get ready by then.
002: What time does tomorrow's class start?
Right. But on Wednesdays, it always starts at nine.
I see. Then I'll leave the house by eight.
I think that's a good idea.
003: Friday? The week is almost over.
Yes, it really went by in a flash.
Do you have any plans for the weekend?
I'm going out with a friend on Saturday.
004: What time do you usually eat dinner in your country?
At my house, it's usually around seven.
Seven? It's the same in Japan.
Is that so? Do you have any special customs?
Nothing in particular, but on Sundays we eat a bit earlier.
That's nice. You can take it easy on Sundays.
005: Excuse me, what time does the station close?
This station is open twenty-four hours.
Yes, the last train is at twelve thirty, but the station itself stays open.
006: I only have class in the morning on Mondays.
Yes, I have nothing in the afternoon.
If you'd like, shall we have lunch together?
Sounds good. Let's make it at twelve.
007: What time do you think it is now?
Maybe around eleven, don't you think?
Wow, is it already that time?
Yes, and I'm getting hungry too.
Then shall we go get lunch soon?
Sounds good. What should we eat?
008: What time do you wake up every morning?
I usually wake up at six thirty.
That's early. I wake up around seven.
I see. Do you eat breakfast?
009: Until what time is this store open?
It's open until nine at night.
Yes, but on Sundays it's open until six.
I see. I'll keep that in mind.
Yes, when you come on Sunday, please come early.
010: Yes, I think it's probably accurate.
My watch seems to be five minutes slow.
Oh, then you should fix it.
You're right. I'll fix it right now.
